newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries mixed, barely budge on steady Fed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries mixed, barely budge on steady Fed.

text.p: *US Treasuries stay narrowly mixed as Fed leaves rates steady
*Traders say market attempting relief rally, with hopes of pushing Sept T-bond to 114-16/32.
*Long end continues to outperform curve on reports of unwinding of steepeners, putting on new flattening trades
